name: Ashwall Tier-Hop Courier Full Transit Rig
description:
Built for moving through every tier in a single shift. Core layer: a slim-cut reversible jacket — Circuit grey on one face, Tier 3 charcoal professional on the other, each side clean enough to pass. Underneath: a collarless base layer in neutral sand that reads as deliberate minimalism above Tier 2. Slim cargo trousers with hidden compartments at the thigh and calf, tailored enough for a Tier 4 lobby. Shoes split the difference — clean enough for an elevator, grippy enough for a fire escape.

Hood with integrated filter, collapsible into a collar. Neural port cap is a neutral brushed-metal — no corporate logo. Everything folds flat into the sling bag.
functionality: Reversible jacket for rapid tier-presentation switching, hidden cargo compartments at thigh and calf, collapsible filter hood, neutral BCI port cap with no identifying markings, grippy-yet-clean sole profile, and full kit packs flat into a standard sling bag.
what_it_says: You belong everywhere and nowhere, and you've made a living out of the fact that no one can quite place you.
worn_by: info brokers doing their own runs
journalists working protected sources across tier lines
story_hooks: The hidden calf compartment contains a sealed package that's been there for three weeks — the client who sent it has stopped responding to messages.
A Tier 4 security AI has flagged this outfit's thermal signature twice in the same building; someone is pattern-matching the courier's routes.
The reversible jacket's Circuit-grey side has a small hand-drawn mark inside the collar — a Shelf gang sign indicating this person is under informal protection.
